steps.note: Enable multi-stage eRFX projects required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Provide the required event title.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: on the eRFX create screen, add one required Terms and Conditions clause and stop with the clause visibly saved

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Publish the configured eRFX event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the first invited QA vendor answer the Technical stage and submit a quote of 100.
Verify the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Have the second invited QA vendor answer the Technical stage and submit a quote of 90.
Verify the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before evaluation and award.
Complete evaluator scoring of the submitted Technical responses.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding and evaluation.
Verify that the lower RFQ amount ranks first, establishing the L1 result.
Award the complete quantity to the lowest bidder.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award when the current session is the pending approver.
Complete the approved award flow and create the purchase order(s).
Verify that the resulting PO carries the single PR line with quantity 10.
Navigate to the events list to check the event's post-award history placement.
Open the History tab after the event completes.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
